propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) in acli_graph.py page through opaque nextPageToken cursors but have no test exercising more than one page

The cursor loop terminates on isLast OR null/absent nextPageToken, but no assertion verifies cursor advances, second pages are fetched, repeated tokens do not spin forever, or short pages do not stop early

A regression net of parametrized tests across all three readers seeds 250 items at 100-item pages and asserts complete recovery via set comparison, plus independent oracles for cursor advance, both termination conditions, and repeated-token spin detection
A real defect was discovered (filed separately) where a repeated cursor token causes the readers to spin forever, swallowed by fail-open exception handling into silently partial maps

An AST guard scans adapters/jira/*.py to prevent new unpaginated whole-project readers posting to /rest/api/3/search/jql without nextPageToken loops, closing a seam left open on Cloud by DC's guard scanning only the DC transport
Seven mutation tests confirm the loop's logic: breaking after page one, break-on-short-page, not echoing cursor, dropping either stop condition, and vacuous guard drift all fail the oracles
